title: Article 318 — Power to make regulations as to conditions of service of members and staff of the Commission

content.overview: Article 318 empowers the President (in the case of the UPSC or a Joint Commission) or the Governor of the State (in the case of a State Commission) to make regulations determining the number of members of the Commission and their conditions of service, and making provision with respect to the number of staff of the Commission and their conditions of service. Conditions of service of a member shall not be varied to his disadvantage after his appointment.
content.glance: President (UPSC/Joint) or Governor (SPSC) makes regulations on number and conditions of service of members and staff. Member’s conditions not varied to disadvantage after appointment.
content.study:
Article 318 regulatory power:
- President: UPSC and Joint Commission.
- Governor: State Commission.
- Subject-matter: number of members; conditions of service of members; number and conditions of service of staff.
- Protection: member’s conditions of service not varied to disadvantage after appointment.

Examination: who makes regulations; non-disadvantageous variation for members.

sections.heading: Key rules
sections.body:
1. President (UPSC/Joint) or Governor (SPSC) may make regulations on strength and conditions of service of members and staff.
2. Conditions of service of a member not to be varied to his disadvantage after appointment.

questionsAndAnswers.question: Who regulates the conditions of service of PSC members and staff?
questionsAndAnswers.answer: Under Article 318, the President in the case of the UPSC or a Joint Commission, and the Governor of the State in the case of a State Commission, may by regulations determine the number of members of the Commission and their conditions of service and make provision with respect to the number of members of the staff of the Commission and their conditions of service. The conditions of service of a member of a Public Service Commission shall not be varied to his disadvantage after his appointment.

examTips: President/Governor regulations; no disadvantageous variation after appointment.

keyTakeaways: Art 318: regulations for PSC members and staff.
